patterns.component_pattern: All UI components use forwardRef, support label/helperText/error props, and follow the Input component API design
patterns.styling_pattern: Components use shared base styles with normal and error variants, dark mode support via Tailwind dark: prefix
patterns.accessibility_pattern: Components use automatic ID generation (useId), aria-invalid, aria-describedby for error/helper text association
patterns.export_pattern: Components are exported from components/ui/index.ts with named exports including component and type definitions
patterns.testing_pattern: Tests use Vitest + @testing-library/react, located in __tests__ subdirectories

existing_implementations.description: Found existing Input component with comprehensive label, error, helper text, and accessibility features. Also found 15+ inline select elements that need to be replaced.
